steps.en: Install the adapter for your framework
steps.zh: 安装对应框架的适配包

steps.en: Register a shortcut in a component with a platform-neutral binding
steps.zh: 在组件里用不分平台的写法登记快捷键

steps.en: Adds it to the shared manager and removes it again on unmount
steps.zh: 登记到共享管理器，组件卸载时自动注销

steps.en: Maps Mod to Cmd on macOS or Ctrl elsewhere, and skips plain keys typed in inputs
steps.zh: Mod 在 macOS 换成 Cmd、别处换成 Ctrl，输入框里打的普通键不算

steps.en: On a match, blocks the browser default and calls your function
steps.zh: 匹配上就拦掉浏览器默认行为，调用你的函数

value.en: Cross-platform shortcuts that do not fight the browser or text fields, without hand-written keydown checks
value.zh: 跨平台的快捷键不跟浏览器和输入框打架，也不用再手写 keydown 判断

sources: docs/installation.md (@tanstack/react-hotkeys and the other adapter package names)
docs/framework/react/quick-start.md (useHotkey('Mod+S', () => { saveDocument() }), Mod resolves to Meta on macOS and Control on Windows/Linux)
docs/framework/react/guides/hotkeys.md (defaults: preventDefault true, stopPropagation true, smart ignoreInputs, conflictBehavior 'warn')
docs/overview.md (framework adapters register and remove bindings on unmount)
